label: The validator registry defines 42 rules across three implementation families: shell rules under runtime/cli/rules/, TypeScript rules (ts:spec-doc-structure and validation/*.ts), and native orchestrator rules (runtime/lib/validation/orchestrator.ts); categories separate authored_template from structural and operational_runtime.

METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY compares three recorded values against the folder's real /specs/ path: description.json specFolder, graph-metadata.json spec_folder, and the frontmatter packet_pointer in implementation-summary.md/handover.md/spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md/decision-record.md; it is enforcing by default with a SPECKIT_METADATA_DISK_CONSISTENCY_ENFORCE=false opt-out.

FILE_EXISTS derives required documents from the level contract templates/spec-kit-docs.json via utils/template-structure.js; phase parents require a lean trio (spec.md, description.json, graph-metadata.json) and lifecycle documents gate only after implementation starts (a checked - [x] item exists in tasks.md).

TEMPLATE_SOURCE checks the SPECKIT_TEMPLATE_SOURCE marker only on the documents the level contract names and skips absent files; spec-kit-docs.json carries a version per template (e.g. spec.md.tmpl v2.2), which is the handle for stale-template detection.

GREP_CONVENTION is a Node-helper classifier over frontmatter presence, trigger-phrase quality, anchor grammar and basename naming; its header states ANCHORS_VALID in the orchestrator owns pairing and order while bash owns grammar, so one anchor defect can surface under two rule names.

FRONTMATTER_VALID checks authored top-level fields and consults lib/frontmatter-grandfather-allowlist.json, an explicit grandfathering path for pre-contract documents that any heal tool must respect rather than rewrite.

The path-drift family has a producer shape: recorded path values are written at generation time and are not proven to be re-derived by move/archive operations; whether archive.sh re-derives after moving is the open producer question. (INFERRED; confirm by reading archive.sh.)

direction: Treating the validation rules themselves as the defect source
reason: Every rule reads a contract (level manifest, template headers, generated metadata) rather than inventing constraints; fixes belong in producers.

direction: Unifying GREP_CONVENTION and ANCHORS_VALID anchor checks
reason: The grammar/pairing split is intentional per the rule header; merging is not justified by evidence.
